test-set.name: file-create-dir
test-set.description: Tests for the extension functions in the EXPath "file" package. The tests rely on being able to modify a “sandpit” folder. The sandpit element in the environment instructs the test driver to copy that folder to a “sandpit” directory in a temporary location and set the current working directory to that temporary location.

test-case.name: EXPath-file-createDir-001
test-case.description: Create directory: parent exists but target doesn't

test-case.name: EXPath-file-createDir-002
test-case.description: Create directory: parent exists and target already exists (spec unclear)

test-case.name: EXPath-file-createDir-003
test-case.description: Create directory: parent exists and target already exists as a file
test-case.test: file:delete("dir3", true()), file:create-dir("dir3"), file:write-text("dir3/test", "text"), file:create-dir("dir3/test"), file:list("dir3/test")

test-case.name: EXPath-file-createDir-004
test-case.description: Create directory: parent already exists as a file
test-case.test: file:delete("dir3", true()), file:create-dir("dir3"), file:write-text("dir3/test", "text"), file:create-dir("dir3/test/dir4"), file:list("dir3/test")

test-case.name: EXPath-file-createDir-005
test-case.description: Create directory: create several levels of directory
